caption: From a single document to a connected health history: extraction, normalization, a structured event, then the graph. Precise, source-aware, no manual entry. Discover HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop. #HealthGraph #HealthData #DataPipeline #StructuredData #HealthTimeline #HealthHistory #DigitalHealth #HealthJournal

lines.beat: records-upload screen; a mono data label 'PDF · max 50 MB' sits on an incoming file frame, instrumentation-style
the file frame docks into the pipeline; label 'STAGE 01 / EXTRACT' stamps on

lines.text: The app extracts the fields: dates, values, units.
lines.beat: field labels (DATE, VALUE, UNIT) parse out of the document rows and link with thin lines
label 'STAGE 02 / NORMALIZE' stamps; values realign into a mono column grid

lines.text: Dates become timestamps, values become consistent measurements.
lines.beat: date strings snap into timestamp ticks; numbers align to the baseline with tick marks

lines.text: Stage three, a structured health event.
lines.beat: label 'STAGE 03 / EVENT'; an event card assembles from parts: date, value, source document

lines.text: Each event keeps a link to the original document.
lines.beat: a source-link edge draws from the event card back to the document frame; a mono label confirms it

lines.text: Stage four, the event joins the timeline.
lines.beat: label 'STAGE 04 / TIMELINE'; the event lands between 2 OCT and 3 OCT on a growing timeline
cut to health-graph screen; a new node connects, edges draw between nodes

lines.text: No manual entry, no lost files.
lines.beat: a tidy grid of event cards; the document frame glows in the 'Past uploads' list
end card: the full pipeline strip (doc, extract, event, graph) behind the CTA
